pages.title: A Stirring Discovery
pages.text: Give magical preparation a consumable branch.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Choose an installed elixir recipe in JEI, provide its actual cauldron ingredients and take the completed drink. A placed empty cauldron is not enough.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Alchemist cauldron requires water, valid input and a bottle; it makes elixirs, upgrades ink and recycles scrolls.
